name: Desigualdad: índice de Gini
description: Gini index
sourceNote: Gini index measures the extent to which the distribution of income (or, in some cases, consumption expenditure) among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution. A Lorenz curve plots the cumulative percentages of total income received against the cumulative number of recipients, starting with the poorest individual or household. The Gini index measures the area between the Lorenz curve and a hypothetical line of absolute equality, expressed as a percentage of the maximum area under the line. Thus a Gini index of 0 represents perfect equality, while an index of 100 implies perfect inequality.
sourceOrganization: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform. Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database. A Lorenz curve plots the cumulative percentages of total income received against the cumulative number of recipients, starting with the poorest individual or household. The Gini index measures the area between the Lorenz curve and a hypothetical line of absolute equality, expressed as a percentage of the maximum area under the line. Thus a Gini index of 0 represents perfect equality, while an index of 100 implies perfect inequality.

Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database. name: Acceso a agua potable básica
description: People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population)
sourceNote: The percentage of people using at least basic water services.  This indicator encompasses both people using basic water services as well as those using safely managed water services.  Basic drinking water services is defined as drinking water from an improved source, provided collection time is not more than 30 minutes for a round trip.  Improved water sources include piped water, boreholes or tubewells, protected dug wells, protected springs, and packaged or delivered water.

sourceNote: The percentage of people using at least basic sanitation services, that is, improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households.  This indicator encompasses both people using basic sanitation services as well as those using safely managed sanitation services.   Improved sanitation facilities include flush/pour flush to piped sewer systems, septic tanks or pit latrines; ventilated improved pit latrines, composting toilets or pit latrines with slabs.

name: Valor agregado de manufactura
description: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)
sourceNote: Manufacturing includes industries classified in ISIC (Rev. 3) major division C and is defined as the physical or chemical transformation of materials or components into new products. Value added is the contribution to the economy by a producer or an industry or an institutional sector, which is estimated by the total value of output produced and deducting the total value of intermediate consumption of goods and services used to produce that output. This indicator is expressed as a percentage of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) which is the total income earned through the production of goods and services in an economic territory during an accounting period.

name: Regla de Sahm en tiempo real EE. UU.
description: Diferencia entre la media móvil de tres meses del desempleo y el mínimo de esas medias en los 12 meses previos. Serie en tiempo real publicada por FRED; umbral de referencia 0,50 p.p.; no es una probabilidad.

name: Actividad nacional de Chicago Fed
description: Cero representa el crecimiento tendencial histórico; valores positivos indican crecimiento superior a la tendencia y negativos inferior.

name: Actividad de Chicago Fed, media de 3 meses
description: Media móvil de tres meses del CFNAI publicada por Chicago Fed. No es crecimiento porcentual del PBI.

name: Pendiente UST 10 años − 3 meses
primarySource: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / U.S. Treasury
description: Diferencia entre los rendimientos del Tesoro a 10 años y a 3 meses; una cifra negativa indica inversión de este tramo de la curva.

name: Salario por hora privado EE. UU.
description: Promedio de ingresos brutos por hora de todos los empleados privados; desestacionalizado. Los cambios de composición del empleo afectan el promedio.

name: Personas desempleadas EE. UU.
description: Desempleados de 16 años y más de la encuesta de hogares CPS, desestacionalizado. Compatible temporalmente con JOLTS, aunque proviene de una encuesta diferente.

name: Inflación implícita EE. UU. a 5 años
primarySource: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / U.S. Treasury
description: Diferencia entre rendimiento nominal y real de títulos del Tesoro a cinco años; incluye expectativas y primas de riesgo/liquidez.

name: Tasa de facilidad de depósito del BCE
description: Tasa de depósitos a un día en el Eurosistema. Composición cambiante de la zona euro; serie diaria de siete días.

name: PBI real de la zona euro, 19 países
description: PBI real trimestral, desestacionalizado, en millones de euros encadenados de 2010. Cobertura fija de 19 países de la zona euro, no todos sus miembros actuales.

name: IPCA de la zona euro, 19 países
description: Índice armonizado de precios al consumidor, total; sin ajuste estacional. Base 2025=100 según metadatos vigentes; cobertura de 19 países.

name: Repos inversos a un día de la Reserva Federal
primarySource: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
description: Valor agregado diario de operaciones temporales de recompra inversa de la Fed. Es una operación de mercado abierto, no una medida directa de dinero invertible.

name: Crédito comercial e industrial EE. UU.
primarySource: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
description: Préstamos comerciales e industriales de todos los bancos comerciales; nivel mensual desestacionalizado (H.8).

name: Crédito bancario total EE. UU.
primarySource: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
description: Crédito de todos los bancos comerciales, desestacionalizado. Semanas terminadas en miércoles (H.8); comprende préstamos y valores.

name: Yuan por dólar estadounidense
primarySource: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
description: Tipo comprador al mediodía en Nueva York (H.10). Una subida indica depreciación del yuan frente al dólar.

name: Dólar estadounidense por euro
primarySource: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
description: Tipo comprador al mediodía en Nueva York (H.10). Una subida indica apreciación del euro frente al dólar.

name: Expectativa de inflación a 12 meses
description: Expectativa de inflación a 12 meses de la encuesta de expectativas macroeconómicas del BCRP. Es una expectativa, no inflación observada.
